channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Purvodaya' vision accelerating development in Northeast, says PM Modi
item.description: PM Modi praised the 2024 Peace Accord with NLFT and ATTF, noting the state's commitment to environmental initiatives, natural farming, and economic reforms. He reiterated the goal of transforming Tripura in line with its historical vision and continued development efforts.

item.title: Gaurav's wife Akanksha's deep neckline, Tamannaah looks uncomfortable; Avneet Kaur fat-shamed
item.description: From Avneet Kaur's bubblegum pink Gen-Z fashion to Tamannaah Bhatia's ill-fitted and overly body-hugging silhouette outfit, and Gaurav Khanna with Akanksha twinning in black but failing to impress fans with their couture, to Prateik's actor wife Priya's see-through outfit. Here's a look at Bollywood's boldest fashion moments at the awards.

item.title: Nana Patekar walks out of O Romeo trailer launch as Shahid Kapoor–Tripti Dimri arrive late; Vishal Bhardwaj reacts
item.description: Nana Patekar walked out of the O Romeo trailer launch after a long delay caused by Shahid Kapoor and Tripti Dimri arriving late. Filmmaker Vishal Bhardwaj reacted to Nana's exit at the trailer launch.

item.title: Anup Jalota advises AR Rahman after composer's communal bias and lack of work
item.description: Music composer AR Rahman sparked controversy after stating in an interview that he might not be getting work in Bollywood due to a power shift and possible communal bias in the industry. His remarks drew criticism from several celebrities. Recently, singer Anup Jalota suggested that Rahman should reconvert to Hinduism.

item.title: Trump calls US world's hottest economy, slams NATO and pushes Greenland talks: Top quotes by US president in Davos
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday addressed the World Economic Forum in Davos. From pushing for a US takeover of Greenland to claiming unfair treatment by NATO, here are the top quotes by the POTUS.

item.title: Haryana wins big at Khelo India Winter Games; bags two golds in figure skating
item.description: Haryana dominated the second day of the Khelo India Winter Games 2026 in Leh, clinching two gold medals in figure skating as the sport made its debut at the event. Ladakh thrilled home crowds by defeating ITBP 3–1 in an action-packed ice hockey encounter, while Haryana moved to the top of the medal standings.

item.title: The 50's house tour: Lavish garden, Lion's den; Divya Agarwal, Shiv Thakare, Karan Patel among contestants
item.description: The latest promo of The 50 offers a glimpse into the show's rules and format, along with a house tour of the grand palace. The show will air from February 1, 2026, with 50 contestants set to be locked inside the house.

item.title: LoC tension ahead of Republic Day: Pakistan violates ceasefire, IED recovered in Shopian
item.description: Ahead of Republic Day, Pakistan violated the ceasefire along the LoC in North Kashmir's Keran sector, prompting a strong retaliation by the Indian Army. In a major security boost, forces recovered and defused a six-kg IED in Shopian.

item.title: Greenland and the return of unconstrained power
item.description: The Greenland crisis is not an episode to be managed and forgotten. It is an inflection point. If coercive leverage over allies succeeds, the precedent will ripple far beyond the Arctic. If it fails, the cost will be borne in fractured trust and diminished legitimacy.

item.title: No fresh MBBS counselling possible in J&K; SMVDIME students face uncertain future
item.description: Even as Chief Minister Omar Abdullah assured relocation of SMVDIME medical students to other colleges, JKBOPEE has said it lacks the authority to conduct fresh MBBS counselling beyond the MCC schedule.
